push.title: W 4-1 vs Negymar FC | You: 9.8 (2nd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
BellyTb1, if I could bottle that 9.8, I'd sell it at every gas station from here to Wichita.

THE GOOD
+ 7 shots at Negymar FC's goal. Shoot your shot. You did, over and over.
+ Man of the Match, your 14th for us. That's leadership you can't fake.
+ Match rating 9.8, up from your usual 8.0. You can build a whole match on that.
+ On-ball actions 44, up from your usual 30. More of that, please and thank you.
+ Part of a 4-1 beating of Negymar FC. Moments like that are why we keep showing up.

THE BAD
- 70% passing (23 of 33, down from your usual 78%). Little adjustment: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
- Missed tackles 4, up from your usual 2. Not who you are, but it was who showed up.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. That's the one I'd circle in red.
- Shots on target: 86%. Solid, but the best forwards hit 90%+.

Five minutes of this: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.

Before you go, BellyTb1: Football's like a casserole. Everybody brings something.

You make this job too easy. Don't tell the gaffer. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-1 vs Negymar FC | You: 9.0 (5th best match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 9.0. You played like someone who read the playbook twice and highlighted it.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at Negymar FC's goal. The more you shoot, the luckier you get.
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 2). Making chances is a gift, and you were Santa Claus tonight.
+ Completed passes 42, up from your usual 20. That's the reliable kind of good.
+ You found BellyTb1 and BellyTb1 found the net. That's chemistry you can't buy at the store.
+ A 9.0 ranks as your 5th best match performance of the season. That's who you are on a good day.

THE BAD
- Giveaways 12, up from your usual 7. That's the bit that kept us from winning.
- Missed tackles 4, up from your usual 2. Coach's secret: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.
- Shots on target: 67%. Halfway to the summit; the peak is 90%+.

Work on: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.

Between you and me, PhogsToffees: The grass isn't greener on the other side; it's greener where you water it.

That's the kind of night that makes me glad I took this job. - Coach Lasso
